Subject: Need help with a anticipatory bail case

Hello, my name is Uma Srivastava. I am a 51-year-old hardware dealer living in Lucknow. Divya More has filed a police complaint against me over Rs 13,40,000, and the complainant alleges cheating over a failed deal. My case number is Anticipatory Bail Application No. 1007/2025 in the Lucknow Sessions Court. Can your firm advise me on what to do next? You can call me on +91 77826 66962 or email uma.srivastava@example.com.
